verses.html: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.text: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.title: A Song of degrees.

verses.html: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.text: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.

verses.html: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.text: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

verses.html: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.text: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.html: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.text: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.

verses.html: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.text: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.html: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.text: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

verses.html: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.text: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
